copy.headline: Portland Timbers host FC Dallas in Western Conference semifinals
copy.caption:
Dallas either advances with a win or hosts a winner-take-all game next weekend. The Timbers are 11-12-6 against Western Conference opponents.

Kristoffer Velde paces the ninth-ranked scoring team in the MLS with 12 goals. Dallas is 14-6-10 in Western Conference games.

story.title: Portland Timbers host FC Dallas in Western Conference semifinals
story.summary: Dallas either advances with a win or hosts a winner-take-all game next weekend. FC Dallas (16-8-10, third in the Western Conference during the regular season) vs. Portland Timbers (13-14-7, eighth in the Conference during the regular season), Portland, Oregon; Saturday, 9:30 p.m. CST LINE: Portland +108, FC Dallas +197; over/under is 3.5 goals BOTTOM LINE: The Portland Timbers host Dallas in the Western Conference semifinals. The Timbers are 11-12-6 against Western Conference opponents. Kristoffer Velde paces the ninth-ranked scoring team in the MLS with 12 goals. The Timbers have scored 62. Dallas is 14-6-10 in Western Conference games. Dallas ranks third in the Western Conference with 62 goals, led by Petar Musa with 22.
